items.text: On an identified standalone candidate, the local workflow journey supports plan creation and revision, real tool execution, draft creation, actual review/registration, reuse on new inputs and two refinements, with the workflow's declared part and native transitions observable; evidence identifies gaps at every receiving join. Verified by VER-001. [REQ-001; E1 V4-EXM-10]

verification.text: Exercise the local end-to-end workflow-making journey from an empty project folder on an identified App/Codex candidate: revise the plan, execute real tools, create the draft, observe the person's review and explicit registration, reuse new inputs, then refine twice. Record native transitions, declared-part visibility, the actual identities used and any failed joins. The two refinements come from V4-EXM-10; this check supplies focused evidence to the separate qualification under CLM-005. Verifies AC-001. [E1 V4-EXM-10; B2]

items.text: Creation and changed-definition cases remain drafts without both the person's review of the identified content and explicit registration; an observed positive case registers the reviewed definition and a subsequent changed definition again requires its own reviewed registration. Verified by VER-002. [REQ-002; P1 V4-WF-02]

verification.text: Run new-definition and changed-definition fixtures with review absent, explicit registration absent, and both actually performed on identified content. Compare draft/catalog states and review/registration evidence; confirm a revision is not silently registered by carrying forward a prior act. Verifies AC-002. [P1 V4-WF-02]

items.text: A registration collision produces an explicit visible disposition and no silent overwrite of the existing workflow; the observed retained or changed content agrees with that disposition. Verified by VER-003. [REQ-003; P1 V4-WF-02]

verification.text: Exercise registration collisions and source selection across project, user, bundled and host-supplied definitions. Introduce same-name definitions and change catalog discovery after selection; compare the selected source/content and existing definition before and after, plus visible dispositions. Check the no-overwrite and no-rebinding criteria separately in the retained results. Verifies AC-003 and AC-004. [P1 V4-WF-02–03]

items.text: Definitions from all four named origin classes retain their source-qualified identities; same-name discovery or catalog changes do not silently change an existing selection's origin or definition. Verified by VER-003. [REQ-004; P1 V4-WF-03]

verification.text: Exercise registration collisions and source selection across project, user, bundled and host-supplied definitions. Introduce same-name definitions and change catalog discovery after selection; compare the selected source/content and existing definition before and after, plus visible dispositions. Check the no-overwrite and no-rebinding criteria separately in the retained results. Verifies AC-003 and AC-004. [P1 V4-WF-02–03]

items.text: At the workspace interfaces, selected/draft content identity, actual supply/adoption and observed behavior remain distinguishable; supplied missing-capability/checkpoint/unknown-outcome conditions retain their true standing without registration being offered as proof of execution compatibility. Verified by VER-004. [REQ-005; CLM-003; A1 §3; E1 V4-EXM-14]

verification.text: Check native receiving and execution-contract fixtures using the actual supplied draft/selected content identity and returned conditions: available versus missing required capability, pending human checkpoint and unknown outcome. Compare what was resolved, supplied/adopted and observed; verify the workspace conveys each truthfully. Local receiving fixtures do not claim an external live round trip. Verifies AC-005. [CLM-002; CLM-003; A1 §3; E1 V4-EXM-14]

items.text: An actual human review/registration case is faithfully recorded and presented with the human actor distinct from any recorder and bound to its content, scope and purpose. Negative cases cannot fabricate review/registration or other human acts from execution success, approval of a different subject, silence or agent recommendation; independently evidenced acts are not forced into an invented acceptance-first chain. Verified by VER-005. [REQ-006; CLM-004; P1 V4-WF-02 and V4-AUT-03]

verification.text: Inspect a positive faithfully recorded human review/registration act and separate decision-actor/recorder evidence. Pair it with no-act, mismatched-content/subject, execution-success and agent-recommendation negatives; inspect independent checking/acceptance/approval evidence without inventing an ordering prerequisite. Confirm the display claims only the act and content actually supported. Verifies AC-006. [CLM-004; P1 V4-AUT-03 and V4-REC-05; D1 decision 03]

items.text: The receiving/reuse account covers native plans/tools, requests/outcomes/attachments, declaration, capability/checkpoint and record joins, names each contribution and owner, preserves optional legacy reuse and unresolved placement, and shows how the chosen Codex integration serves the required workspace behavior. Verified by VER-006. [REQ-007; OUT-004; CLM-002; CLM-003; CLM-004; A1 §3; C1]

verification.text: Review the implementation/receiving/reuse account and local results against the accepted row, source clauses and ownership claims. Trace every anticipated artifact and interface; compare required catalog/registration behavior with the chosen reuse disposition; confirm unresolved means remain carried, candidate/evidence identities are present, and the independent qualification return is distinct. Verifies AC-007 and AC-008. [B2; CLM-001; CLM-002; CLM-003; CLM-004; CLM-005; CLM-006; C1]

items.text: The local fixture results and receiving account bind the actual candidate and scope, retain integration accountability here, and provide focused evidence to the independent examiner without claiming another owner's construction, human decision or joined qualification was performed. Verified by VER-006. [REQ-008; CLM-001; CLM-005; CLM-006; B2]
